name: DLF
one_liner: DLF develops, leases, and manages residential, commercial, and retail real estate properties in India.
what_you_sell: Commercial office space, retail mall properties, residential developments, and hospitality properties.
target_group: DLF sells commercial office leases and retail mall spaces to mid-sized and enterprise companies expanding in India. A ideal target is a company with over 100 employees in technology, financial services, or retail seeking Grade-A office space or prime retail storefronts in major Indian commercial hubs like Gurugram, Delhi, or Chennai.
b2c_note: DLF also sells residential homes and apartments directly to individual consumers.
who_uses_it: Employees working in corporate office complexes, retail store operators, and residential property buyers.
who_pays_for_it: Companies leasing commercial office space, retail brands renting mall space, and individual homebuyers.
who_buys_it: Heads of Corporate Real Estate, Facilities Directors, and Retail Expansion Managers looking for office or store space in India.
_claims_to_check: Claims over 78 years of real estate development and management experience.
Claims to have delivered 32.63 million square meters of real estate.
Claims to be the largest publicly listed real estate company in India.
Claims active property developments spanning 15 states and 24 cities.
